# View linting checks - 2026-11-08

## Configuration and enforcement

- `bundle exec haml-lint --no-color`: 9 files inspected, 0 lints; final verification.
- A deliberately invalid partial supplied through `--stdin app/views/matches/_lint_probe.html.haml` produced four lints and exit 65: static hash class, missing call parentheses, double-quoted Ruby string, and missing strict locals. No probe file was created.
- `ClassAttributeWithStaticValue` only checks a simple valid class name, not the full shorthand/HTML/hash hierarchy. `HtmlAttributes` prefers the opposite syntax and is disabled. The requested fallback order is documented for manual review.
- Manual review of all nine templates confirmed static classes use shorthand where supported, interpolated class values use HTML-style attributes, and Ruby attribute hashes are reserved for structured/non-class attributes.
- Long Tailwind/helper lines are allowed. RuboCop is focused on string literals and call parentheses; macro exceptions are disabled so silent `content_for` calls are covered. Block-style conditionals are preserved.

## Rendering and Rails checks

| Command | Result | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails db:prepare` | Passed | Test database preparation |
| `bin/rails test test` | 112 tests, 6,788 assertions, no failures/errors/skips | Final full non-browser suite |
| `bin/rails tailwindcss:build` | Passed | Final Tailwind build |
| `bin/rails zeitwerk:check` | All is good | Final application loading check |

The request tests cover setup defaults, history collections and pagination, active/completed boards, translations, accessible forms, and rejection of missing/unexpected partial locals. Browser testing was not performed.

## Dependency investigation

Initial resolution chose RuboCop 1.31, whose executable failed under Ruby 4 with missing `benchmark`. Constraining RuboCop to `~> 1.81` resolved 1.92.2 and fixed execution. Bundler also selected compatible Prism 1.9.0. No unrelated standalone Ruby files were reformatted.

## Review

Code-quality review found no unresolved issues. Template responsibilities, helper calls, complete Tailwind classes, accessibility attributes, and form ownership are preserved. Current composition examples and finishing instructions match the implementation. All initiative success criteria are met.
